title: Sharp Normalized Covariance Bounds and Constant-Stretch Correlated Sampling on the Hypersimplex
summary: We establish the normalized covariance bound conjectured by Anari et al. (2026, Conjecture 3) for fixed-rank external-field measures. Let $d\ge2$ and $m\in[d-1]$. For $w\in(0,+\infty)^d$, let $\mathsf S$ be an $m$-subset of $[d]$ with rank-$m$ external-field law $\mathbb P(\mathsf S=S)=\frac{\prod_{i\in S}w_i}{e_m(w)},S\subseteq[d],|S|=m,$ where $e_m(w):=\sum_{T\subseteq[d], |T|=m}\prod_{\ell\in T}w_\ell$ is the $m$th elementary symmetric polynomial in $w_1,\dots,w_d$.
